page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor cores running at 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core processing is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 10% to 25% tier. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by average ratings in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth benchmarks show average read and write speeds, though the overall PassMark memory score is positioned in the lower 25%.

Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads that do not require high single-threaded performance. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage. It is well-suited for database operations, Redis caching, static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks such as software compilation or light language model inference.
